title: AI-Enhanced IoT System for Assessing Bridge Deflection in Drive-By Conditions.
summary: A lab-scale bridge-and-vehicle setup compared MEMS/edge-sensor estimates with reference laser-triangulation displacement measurements and an Euler–Bernoulli model. The results support indirect estimation of static bridge deflection under tested drive-by conditions; this remains a controlled setup, not field deployment.
